claims.summary: The V0.16.90 production course completed correctly but briefly showed a stale local-save failure before recovering.
Only the newest autosave attempt may settle visible saved, failed, or idle state.
Starting another save or resetting the workspace invalidates callbacks from older persistence attempts.
Exact browser persistence retries one transient storage abort and preserves both causes if the retry also fails.
Chromium preserves oversized exact projects and restores a quota-saturated 15-lesson package from IndexedDB without a visible local-save failure.
The patch changes persistence orchestration only and adds no model, compiler-quality, instructor, factual, accessibility, classroom, or paid-model claim.
